# infrawrench_heartbeat (Resource)

A heartbeat monitor for a scheduled job. The job pings `ping_url` each time it runs (`/start` before, `/fail` on failure); when a ping is later than the schedule plus `grace_minutes`, the heartbeat goes `down` and raises a `heartbeatAlerts` notification.

Set exactly one of `cron_expression` (read in `timezone`) and `interval_minutes`. A heartbeat stays `new` until its first ping, so it never alerts before the job has been wired up.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "infrawrench_heartbeat" "nightly_backup" {
  name            = "Nightly backup"
  cron_expression = "0 2 * * *"
  timezone        = "Europe/London"

  # How late the ping may be before the heartbeat goes down and alerts.
  grace_minutes = 30
}

resource "infrawrench_heartbeat" "queue_drain" {
  name             = "Queue drain"
  interval_minutes = 15
  grace_minutes    = 5
}

# Hand the job its ping URL without it appearing in plan output.
output "nightly_backup_ping_url" {
  value     = infrawrench_heartbeat.nightly_backup.ping_url
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name, 1 to 120 characters.

### Optional

- `cron_expression` (String) Five-field cron the job runs on, e.g. `0 2 * * *`. The server refuses an expression it cannot read, or one that never fires.
- `enabled` (Boolean) False pauses the heartbeat. Resuming returns it to `new` until the next ping.
- `field_key` (String) The resource field the schedule was read from. Create-only, like `resource_id`.
- `grace_minutes` (Number) How late a ping may be before the heartbeat goes down, 1 to 10080 minutes.
- `interval_minutes` (Number) Minutes between expected pings, for a job on a fixed interval, 1 to 44640 (31 days).
- `resource_id` (String) The scheduled Infrawrench resource this heartbeat watches; use `data.infrawrench_resources` to resolve one. Advisory rather than a foreign key, and recorded at creation only: the update route does not carry it, so changing it replaces the heartbeat.
- `timezone` (String) IANA time zone `cron_expression` is read in. Defaults to `UTC`.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) Account of the linked resource, when there is one.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned heartbeat id. Use it with `terraform import`.
- `ping_url` (String, Sensitive) The secret URL the job pings. Anyone holding it can record pings, so it is marked sensitive; replace it from the app if it leaks.
- `status` (String) `new` until the first ping, `up` after a success, `down` after a missed deadline or a `/fail` ping.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The id is in the URL when you open the object in the app, and in the
# --json output of the Infrawrench CLI.
terraform import infrawrench_heartbeat.example 3f4a5b6c-7d8e-4f9a-0b1c-2d3e4f5a6b7c
```
